target.acceptance_rule: The newly generated PDF must match this SHA-256 exactly.

learning_pipeline.seed_role: Passed to training/model.py:seeded_initial to create the surrounding-cortex initial state from training/training_inputs.npz.
learning_pipeline.exactness_scope: The archived replay matched initial, step_2500, step_3000, and final arrays bit for bit on the recorded GPU/TensorFlow backend.

render_pipeline.svg_note: Matplotlib-generated internal SVG IDs can vary; PDF byte identity is the acceptance criterion and PNG byte identity is an additional check.

pipeline_order: Seed 2026111604 creates the initial surrounding-cortex state.
The frozen 3000-step learning schedule produces the surrounding-cortex endpoint.
The endpoint, matched V1 fit, saved partition, and injection mapping are frozen into data/figure2_data.npz.
The four render entrypoints generate panels A-E and assemble the one-page PDF.
reproduce.py rejects the run unless the new PDF SHA-256 equals the committed reference.

methods_pipeline.default_fit_inputs: archived V1/HVA endpoints; explicit --v1-fit and --hva-maps accept new endpoints
